// not the other Draft

draft() by ipe Studio

One name, several apps

Many apps and tools use the name “Draft”. draft() on this site is a different product: a voice-first storytelling app made by ipe Studio. You talk for about thirty seconds, answer two or three gentle questions, and get a finished story — hook, rising action, peak, reflection and close — while your words stay yours.

How to tell it is ours

  • Official site: draft.ipe.rest — this site.
  • Maker: ipe Studio — ipe.rest.
  • The name is written draft(), with parentheses, and marked “an ipe studio app”.
  • Platform: iOS, in preparation.
